name: Private application notes stay with their owner across independent browser sessions
description: Browser privacy companion to the mandatory native API ownership test 88b47334-232c-4665-a6a2-413b09c34eb5. Actual 404/403, foreign read exclusion and unchanged owner fields remain enforced by the separate required TestSprite API ownership check; browser visibility is not claimed as server enforcement.

planSteps.description: Sign in as isolated owner VAR_{other_email} using configured VAR_{password}. Navigate directly to VAR_{url}/scholarships/twente-uts-2027, not via discovery/search or a dashboard link. Wait for the scholarship heading and Save/Unsave control. Save if necessary. Expand My application plan, set Private notes to [TEST ONLY] Owner-only application note, click Save my plan, and require Your plan is saved confirmation.

Still as owner, reload that exact scholarship detail URL, expand My application plan and require Private notes to equal [TEST ONLY] Owner-only application note. A saved toast alone does not establish persistence.

Click Sign out. Sign in using the configured second student VAR_{username} and VAR_{password}; wait for the dashboard to finish loading and dismiss Continue study profile later if present. Then explicitly navigate directly to VAR_{url}/scholarships/twente-uts-2027. Do not repeatedly click dashboard/discovery links or reuse an old authenticated tab.

As the second student, verify the owner-only note is absent. If this student has its own My application plan, expand it and verify Private notes is not [TEST ONLY] Owner-only application note. A different note belonging to this second account is valid. Verify there is no Operator navigation item. Do not modify this second account’s note.

Click Sign out and sign back in as original owner VAR_{other_email} using configured VAR_{password}. Wait for the dashboard route; this is an intermediate sign-in result, not the final checkpoint. Explicitly navigate directly to VAR_{url}/scholarships/twente-uts-2027 once, wait for its scholarship heading, and expand My application plan. Do not loop through discovery/search/dashboard links. Fail if this direct navigation cannot open the detail page; do not silently skip it.

Require the current URL to be /scholarships/twente-uts-2027 and Private notes to equal [TEST ONLY] Owner-only application note after returning as owner. All previous owner persistence, second-account absence and no-Operator assertions remain mandatory. HTTP ownership enforcement remains separately required in native API case88b47334-232c-4665-a6a2-413b09c34eb5; hidden UI alone is not server enforcement.
